candidates.title: RSV Vaccine in Transplant Recipients
candidates.study_design: ClinicalTrials.gov study type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE3; allocation: NA
candidates.outcome_domain: RSV prevention, immunization, protection, safety, policy, or implementation signal
candidates.key_finding: Adjuvant, non-live RSV vaccine will be administered to adult lung and allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients. The safety and immunogenicity of this intervention will be studied. Blood work will be collected before and after the intervention, to assess humoral and cellular immunity. Participants will be followed for adverse reaction, hospitalization, RSV breakthrough infection, graft rejection or graft versus host disease. This study has Health Canada and UHN REB approval.

candidates.title: Effects of Food Intake on Biomarker Activity in Normal Humans Taking Immulina
candidates.study_design: ClinicalTrials.gov study type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE2; allocation: RANDOMIZED
candidates.outcome_domain: RSV prevention, immunization, protection, safety, policy, or implementation signal
candidates.key_finding: The need for a generally available product that can safely and effectively increase antiviral resilience in susceptible populations became highly relevant during the recent COVID pandemic. The value continues with the endemic influenza season, which is now joined by COVID and, in susceptible adults, respiratory syncytial virus. The investigators recently completed a NIH-funded U19 project examining the immune potentiating effects of Immulina supplementation on biomarkers associated with antiviral resilience.
